content.question: Which statement about labels in machine learning is true?
options: Reinforcement learning relies on labels called rewards that the environment gives after each action.
Supervised learning requires labeled data, while unsupervised learning works with unlabeled data.
Labels describe the input features of each example rather than the value the model should predict.
content.answer: Supervised learning requires labeled data, while unsupervised learning works with unlabeled data.
